title: Normal FRC CollectionQuery-1 semantic profile
$comment: Additive profile on the unchanged FRC-0.1 envelope. Runtime query_schema.relation_schema supplies the closed value schemas to formalizers; query_profile.validate_relations enforces all cross-facet types/references, complete groups, unique identity ordering and explicit policy authority. JSON Schema alone is not source approval or complete structural coverage.

parameters.$comment: Closed per-facet values are defined by the formalizer's executable relation_schema; additional cross-facet constraints are normative in validate_relations. No prose values are accepted by either native checker.
